name: Creative Workshops
description: Unleash your creative side. This week offers Kintsugi, ceramics painting, and upcycling workshops at studios across the city.
longDescription:
This series of creative workshops, running from June 11th to June 17th, 2026, offers participants the opportunity to engage with various artistic disciplines. The program features sessions dedicated to Kintsugi, the Japanese art of repairing broken pottery with gold; ceramics painting, allowing for personalized decoration of ceramic pieces; and upcycling, transforming discarded materials into new objects. These workshops are hosted by independent studios located throughout Porto.

Attendees can expect hands-on instruction in a studio setting. Each workshop focuses on a specific craft, providing an introduction to techniques and materials. The duration of individual workshops varies depending on the specific activity. The sessions are designed for individuals interested in exploring practical art forms and developing new skills.

Workshop prices vary by activity and studio. Specific ticketing information, including advance booking requirements or walk-in availability, will be detailed closer to the event dates. As the workshops are held at various studios across Porto, transport will depend on the specific location of each chosen session. Information on individual studio accessibility will be available upon registration.
